# LMSR backtest (generated by market/backtest.py; do not edit by hand)

Real Kalshi taker trades replayed as limit orders against an LMSR opened at the noon cutoff. Daily PnL for one six-bin event, in dollars. b and fee were chosen on train days only. A counterfactual estimate, not realized PnL.

348 days after forecast warm-up; intervals resample whole days.

## Synthetic traders: test-day PnL by informed share

Informed traders hold noisy beliefs around the later Kalshi midpoint; the rest trade for reasons unrelated to the outcome. Every seed uses b 300 and fee 0.01, so only the opening forecast differs. This is a what-if, not an estimate of real flow.
